text:
Sarah: heads-up — after the proportional drain change I saw small tenants getting evicted much faster. eviction rate for tenants <10k/day spiked 3x on cluster-g-3 between 02:00-05:00 UTC. dash: https://internal.redwood/monitoring/evict-1805

Dmitri: which metric did you check? can you paste a tiny snippet or the chart id? :thinking:

Sarah: linked. also observed pin_count drop from 4 -> 0 within 200ms after a larger tenant's burst.

Ash: this smells like credit spillover. proportional drain gives hot prefixes credits; when hot pool is small the algorithm reclaims slabs aggressively.

Jordan: we also changed decay to favor recent hotness; so sporadic tiny tenants look cold quickly and become vulnerable even with soft-pins.

Sarah: thinking of mitigations: either a short per-tenant residency floor or a burst-aware multiplier in the score.

Dmitri: floor idea: min_residency_ms = max(1000, 0.2 * burst_window_ms). simple but may bloat the hotset.

Ash: floor helps tail for small tenants but will reduce global hit-rate and increase slab churn. tradeoff.

Jordan: alternate: add burst sensitivity to score instead of hard floor. e.g. score = hotness * (1 + alpha * burst_ratio) - beta * size_penalty.

Sarah: prototype sketch:
```
hotness = recent_accesses / expected_rate
burst_ratio = max(1, recent_peak / recent_mean)
score = hotness * (1 + 0.5 * (burst_ratio - 1)) - 0.1 * log(tenant_tokens + 1)
```
plus soft_grace_ms on first soft-pin.

Dmitri: how compute recent_peak cheaply at scale? max-heap per-prefix is too heavy.

Ash: use EWMM (exp-weighted moving max) approximation. O(1) per event, tunable alpha.

Jordan: add hysteresis so demotion needs two consecutive windows under threshold to avoid oscillation.

Sarah: ops wants better telemetry: add demote_reason tag and emit score_components (hotness, burst_ratio, size_penalty) for sampled ops.

Ash: feature-flag EWMM + burst_score and canary on 2 nodes.

Sarah: rollout plan: soft_grace_ms=1200, EWMM alpha=0.2, burst_alpha=0.5, hysteresis=2 windows. canary cluster-g-3 (2 nodes) on 2026-03-30 03:00 UTC.

Dmitri: +1. add sim smoke tests under kv-cache/sim for mixed tenant sizes and bursts.

Jordan: I'll open an RFC follow-up with the math and SLO metrics to watch: evict-rate-by-tenant-size, slab-churn, hit-rate-90p. tagging @Ash @Sarah.

evict-bot: scheduled canary rollout to cluster-g-3 on 2026-03-30 03:00 UTC (2 nodes). monitor: #ops-alerts.

Sarah: will check first 6 hours and report back. :thumbsup:
